stats.notes: Confirmed the same-tick input bug. With seed 12345, down+right from (1,1) ends at (1,2), so the first key (down) won. The design says the last key pressed counts, so it should end at (2,1). Run 2 (right+down) went to (2,1), which is consistent with first-key-wins. The single token 'down+right' is already minimal. Not yet probed: dash and spikes, lever and gates, pause during dash, dialogs and buttons, the timer and time bonus, and score caps. I stopped here to save budget.
